clusters.mechanism: Owner diagnostic copy is built from the already-clipped (2,000-char) thinking message, so the full original text is lost before being stored.
After rollback to the base release, raw diagnostics persisted in the shared SQLite database are readable by agents because read protection exists only in the new harness code.
INTEGER PRIMARY KEY without AUTOINCREMENT lets SQLite reuse deleted max IDs, so new diagnostics can get already-consumed IDs and be skipped by the id > cursor follow logic.
Preview build/seed/server processes run unconfined checkout code that can query the owner-only table and leak its contents through published preview error output.
